All three changes are minimal and targeted. Here's the summary of fixes:

### Fix 1 — DOM-identity preservation on toggle-all (failures 1 & 2)
**`js/app.js`** — The `toggleAllCheckbox` change handler previously called `render()`, which destroys and recreates all `<li>` elements (`todoList.innerHTML = ''`). In a real browser, Cypress holds live references to the old nodes; when they're replaced, `cy.eq()` detaches. Now it **mutates in-place**: toggles the `completed` class and `checked` attribute on each existing `<li>`, then calls `updateHeaderFooter()`.

### Fix 2 — Hide `.view` during editing (failure 3)
**`css/app.css`** — Added `li.editing .view { display: none; }` so the label (inside `.view`) is hidden when the `<li>` has class `editing`. Previously only `.toggle` and `.destroy` were hidden; the label remained visible.

### Fix 3 — Guard against double-removal in saveEdit (failure 4)
**`js/app.js`** — `saveEdit` is reachable from both `keydown` (Enter) and `blur`. When the edit is empty, the first call removes the `<li>` from the DOM; the second then throws `removeChild: The node to be removed is no longer a child`. Added `if (li.parentNode)` before `removeChild` so the second call is a no-op.
